facts: Swahili trading settlement with African, Arab, Indian, European influences; narrow streets, courtyard homes, carved doors. Location: Outstanding Universal Value.
Old Fort built over earlier Portuguese church; Old Dispensary, St Joseph cathedral and Christ Church at former slave market listed historic monuments. Location: major buildings.
Town is residential, commercial and administrative; conservation threatened by deterioration/development. Location: Integrity/management.
